caseNameFull: James E. DZURENDA, Commissioner, Connecticut Department of Correction v. Odilio GONZALEZ and James E. Dzurenda, Commissioner, Connecticut Department of Correction v. Jourdan E. Huertas.

opinions.text: Motions of respondents for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Connecticut denied.
